data.title: 五和 · 榻榻米被褥间的纯白羞涩献身
data.description: 静谧的日式卧室内暖光微昏。纯白棉质吊带睡裙从雪白香肩彻底滑落，双手按在胸前轻颤的五和满面绯红，眼泛泪光地依偎在你的胸膛上，软软低语“请让我……成为上条先生真正的人吧”。
data.location: traditional Japanese bedroom with soft white futon
data.action: kneeling on futon with nightgown slipping off bare shoulders, tearful eyes looking up with breathless blushing submission and unconditional love
data.lighting: soft warm amber floor lamp illuminating pale curves and flushed cheeks
data.mood: pure sacred devotion, breathtaking maiden surrender, heartfelt lovers consummation
data.promptProse: Kneeling on futon with white nightgown slipping off bare shoulders, Itsuwa blushes heavily with tearful devoted eyes and passionate kisses.
data.animaCaption: Itsuwa with bare shoulders on futon in loving tearful submission.
